channel.title: AY2025 Activity Report :: HaseLab (English)
channel.description: Important This content was automatically translated by an LLM (2026/10/05). The original content is written in Japanese. The following was written on Monday, October 27, 2025. As of April 1, I joined the Architecture, Civil and Environmental Engineering Program, Faculty of Engineering and Design, Kagawa University as an Associate Professor. Two fourth-year students, Ago and Abe, joined the lab. Looking back, my first lab at NIT, Akita College, sixteen years ago also started with two students. The following was written all at once on 2026/10/02.
